declaredStatus.claim: S07 ownership, namespace isolation and generation-bound disable/restore are declared implemented; this report independently reviews one tag subbatch only.

checks.detail: The feature owns tag rules/session state. Internal imports consume public core/plugin-center/ui exports with workspace:*; no app, workbench, private repository or runtime import in the tag package. Host consumes public ports and an injected loader.

The metadata root has only type imports and no runtime dependency edges. Specialist views/state/styles enter through the separate /vue export. The shared loader boundary ignores stale results and supports retry after a rejected import; real application injection is a separate subbatch.

Synchronous generation changes dispose old sessions. Disabled state immediately withdraws user-tag projections while retaining source metadata and namespace values; re-enable restores without writes. Disposed/stale actions reject mutations. Batch IDs deduplicate before one namespace write.

Tag records persist track IDs, labels and update timestamps only. Commits preserve unrelated namespace fields and publish session state only after a successful synchronous write. Host library writes strip user tags and do not change namespaces. Unknown namespace versions are preserved read-only; lazy/session load errors cross the host boundary as AppErrorState.

Tests reside with the plugin and the shared host adapter. Targeted tests cover normalization/search/filter rules, namespace changes, write failure, disable/restore, stale loader and lazy-load retry. 36 tests and both scoped typechecks pass. This is scoped Node automation, not actual page interactions or runtime acceptance.

callChain: Build-known createTagManagementModule returns metadata without importing the /vue entry.

Host read/project observes revision; disable disposes the session and removes tag projections; enable recreates from retained namespace.
